decision.reason: The evidence excerpts [ev-2875a348b5d7] and [ev-59d22c21eec4] contain only "/*", so they show nothing of the code around the added line. The change text shows only that v2.0.0 adds an error return saying external secret store support was removed. It does not show what triggers that return, such as the --enable-external-secret-stores flag being set, or whether the error stops the core pod from starting. The proposed statement admits this itself ("likely fails… does not show the exact condition"), so workload-failure would claim mandatory work the evidence doesn't support. To decide, we need the code around the line in v2.0.0 core.go (the condition and the caller's handling) or a release note or upgrade guide saying what happens when the flag is set.
